_comment: Reference art proving the game HUD is on screen, i.e. that we are actually in play.
Cropped from a real in-game frame (the right-hand orb's stone frame - fixed art that is
always drawn during play and absent in the lobby / character select).
region and search_region are fractions of the ANCHOR WINDOW (see window_region.py), not
of the screen, so they survive the game being windowed, moved or resized.
search_region is deliberately much larger than the art itself: a wider search costs
almost nothing here but tolerates small HUD layout shifts. A FULL-frame search measured
3.0ms/frame against 0.2ms restricted, which is why it is restricted at all.
threshold separates in-play from lobby by a wide margin - measured 0.951 in game and
0.835 with the ESC menu open (HUD still drawn), against 0.343 and 0.329 in two lobbies.
